messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — we need a lightweight asset set for next week's 'Serving Wins' launch (webinar + benchmark drop). Deliverables: one-pager benchmark PDF, 3 social cards, webinar hero, and an email hero. Need a simplified latency vs cost microdiagram and a 1-slide 'routing play' for inbound leads (who to page / SFDC tags). Deadline EOD Thu. Can Design take? cc @Jordan Patel @Sam Gupta @Elaine Ho

Jordan Patel: Yup we can — happy to own visual pieces. Quick Qs: do you want the benchmark microdiagram in full brand colors or a muted palette for clarity? Also, do you want the one-pager left-aligned layout or more modular tiles?

Sam Gupta: For inbound routing, we should add UTM params + a hidden form field source=serving-wins. Also need to confirm MQL criteria — is 1 webinar signup enough or only demo requests? cc @Brandon Li for consent/data capture check.

Elaine Ho: I'll scope templates and component variants. Plan: create a Figma file with tokenized components (hero, microtile, microdiagram, routing slide). Brand note: stick to primary palette and the approved icon set — avoid custom gradients. Guardrails link: https://redwood.design/brand/guardrails

design-bot: Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/abc123/serving-wins-assets (auto)

Jordan Patel: Uploaded first drafts to Figma and tagged the components. Quick preview + sizes below — will iterate after copy and legal signoff.

```
Sizes:
- Hero: 1200x628 (email/webinar hero)
- Social card: 1080x1080 (x3 variants: hero, metric, quote)
- Microtile: 600x600 (for docs and slides)
- One-pager: US Letter PDF (8.5x11 in) + 800px web export
- Routing slide: 1920x1080 (ppt-ready)
```

Jordan Patel: For the microdiagram I mocked two approaches: 1) Sankey-style cost flow (tokens -> compute -> cost) and 2) compact xy chart (latency on x, unit cost on y) with callouts. Which do you prefer?

Maya Chen: Prioritize email hero and microdiagram. I like the compact xy chart for the social tiles, sankey for the one-pager. For routing slide: Sam to provide SFDC owner list and preferred labels. Also include 2 headline variants for social: 'Serving wins: how inference economics scales' and 'Reduce tokens, keep quality' — keep copy short.

Sam Gupta: SFDC routing plan: inbound@redwood.com -> SDR queue -> tag product_interest=serving-wins. UTM params: utm_campaign=serving-wins&utm_source=social. I will add a hidden input `source=serving-wins` and ensure the webhook maps to lead.source. MQL: set to demo_request=true OR company_size >= 50.

Brandon Li: Legal review quick note — no major issues. For webinar registration include explicit opt-in checkbox text: 'I agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference.' Also avoid collecting job titles unless user opts in.

Jordan Patel: Noted. Updated prototypes with opt-in checkbox and UTM examples. Pushed a visual variant that uses muted palette for the microdiagram (better contrast on small screens). Need a 30-min review tomorrow at 2pm to lock copy and finalize exports.

Maya Chen: 2pm review confirmed. Please highlight any accessibility concerns (contrast, alt text) in the Figma comments. Thanks everyone — big push but should be straightforward. :thumbsup:
